title: Poutine
description: Poutine is a dish from Canada prepared with potato, all-purpose flour, mozzarella. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Mozzarella replaces fresh squeaky cheese curds in this home poutine; melting and texture differ.

steps.instruction: Wash and prepare the listed produce; dice or chop evenly for a consistent texture.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 18 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
Melt the fat, stir in flour and cook gently for about 10 minutes, then whisk in liquid to create a smooth thickened sauce.
Assemble the cooled components with the listed fillings or toppings. Refrigerate briefly if needed to set the layers.
